steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each change in the quarter is matched to an environmental aspect.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Change in the quarter with no matching aspect
findings.fix: Add the aspect and its significance

findings.title: Significance rating with no stated basis
findings.fix: State the basis for the rating

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] q-change-line-4.md:12  Change in the quarter with no matching aspect.
       Fix: Add the aspect and its significance.
[medium] aspect-water.md:19  Significance rating with no stated basis.
       Fix: State the basis for the rating.
[low] aspect-waste.md:26  Aspect with no control.
       Fix: Name the control.
Not checked: Impacts not in the records.
pros: Checks a change in the quarter's records with no matching aspect, an aspect with no control, and a significance rating with no stated basis.
cons: Not checked: Impacts not in the records.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-environmental-aspects-review skill on the records for this review.
